Product Features

  • Perfectly sized for large screens: The overall dimensions are 180 x 40 x 48 cm, and the long tabletop provides stable support for a TV of about 80 inches, perfectly meeting the needs of watching TV on large screens in the modern living room.
  • Practical hinged door design: Equipped with 3 hinged doors, does not need an outer pulling field, can be opened and closed in a space-saving way, is easy to operate even in small apartments, and provides more convenient access to the items.
  • The 3D printed design adds a touch of sophistication to the whole: the cabinet doors feature a 3D printed design with offset lines, which gives the plain white cabinet a sense of design and elegance, combining aesthetics and practicality.
  • Stable Construction: Equipped with 6 support legs that distribute the force evenly for greater stability. The recommended total load is 40 kg, so you can safely place TVs and heavy objects on it.
  • Extra large storage space: Inside the three folding doors, there is an extra large storage space in which audiovisual equipment, game consoles, books and other various items can be stored, keeping the living room tidy.
  • Elegant, versatile style in white: The pure white exterior looks elegant and classy, with simple and clean lines that easily blend in with various interior styles such as modern, Nordic and cream, increasing the brightness of the room.
  • Made of high-quality MDF material: It is made of high-quality MDF boards, which are hard and eco-friendly, have a stable and durable structure, have a smooth and easy-to-clean surface, and are not easy to deform even after long-term use.
  • Large storage area: The spacious surface offers space for plants, picture frames, decorative items and other decorations. It serves not only as a practical storage surface, but also as a decorative element in the living room.
  • Practicality and aesthetics go hand in hand: the combination of compatibility with large screens, extra-large storage space, sturdy construction and high-quality design makes it the ideal choice for a modern TV cabinet in the living room.
  • Note: This product is shipped in 2 packages and can be delivered in multiple partial deliveries. Please make sure you have received all the packages before you start building!

Descriptions

Descriptions

The TV cabinet measures 180 x 40 x 48 cm and has three folding doors. The doors are printed and equipped with six support legs for high stability (recommended load capacity: 40 kg). The elegant white color is suitable for TVs up to about 80 inches and offers plenty of storage space. It is made of MDF.
